valuation: v_p(z)=v_p(numerator)-v_p(denominator) for a nonzero reduced rational fraction; infinity for zero
formal_parameter: t=-x/y at each nonidentity rational residual, k=v_p(t)
pattern_check: for a nonidentity residual in the good-reduction kernel, record whether v_p(x)=-2k, v_p(y)=-3k and k>=1
selection_comparison: compare parent minimum-model choice, prior 81-grid choice, and vector-aware maximum-k oracle; use model score then lexicographic shift for oracle ties
